SECTION 1. SHORT TITLE.

This Act may be cited as the "Protecting our Communities from Sexual Predators Act".

SEC. 2. MANDATORY DETENTION OF CERTAIN ALIENS CHARGED WITH SEXUAL ASSAULT.

(a) In General.--Section 236(c) of the Immigration and Nationality
Act (8 U.S.C. 1226(c)) is amended--
    (1) in� subsection (1), by adding at the end the following new
    subparagraph:
        ``(E) is charged with, is convicted of, admits having
        committed, or admits committing acts which constitute the
        essential elements of any offense of sexual assault,''; and
    (2) in subsection (2), by inserting ``(E),'' after ``(D),''.

SEC. 3. INADMISSIBILITY OF ALIENS CONVICTED OF SEXUAL ASSAULT.

(a) In General.--Section 212(a)(2) of the Immigration and Nationality
Act (8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(2)) is amended by adding at the end the
following new subparagraph:
    ``(J) Sexual assault.--Any alien who is convicted of, who admits
    having committed, or who admits committing acts which constitute
    the essential elements of sexual assault is inadmissible.''.

SEC. 4. DEPORTABILITY OF ALIENS CONVICTED OF SEXUAL ASSAULT.

(a) In General.--Section 237(a)(2) of the Immigration and Nationality
Act (8 U.S.C. 1227(a)(2)) is amended by adding at the end the
following new subparagraph:
    ``(G) Sexual assault.--Any alien who is convicted of, who admits
    having committed, or who admits committing acts which constitute
    the essential elements of sexual assault is deportable.''.
